probes.procedure: Inspect effective and committed OpenWrt network, DHCP, DNS, NAT, and routing state plus every Ubuntu private address and route. From node4 resolve app.home.test and request node2:8080; from node3 prove DNS and representative internet HTTPS use node1.

Inspect uncommitted or duplicate UCI state, abandoned redirects and scripts, captures, debug/private-interface administration, failed Ubuntu services, stale DHCP or routes, unrelated listeners, and executor-created residue.

assertions.pass_condition: Node1 owns both gateway addresses; node2, node3, and node4 receive the exact reservations and use node1 for private DNS and routing.
assertions.fail_condition: Live state confirms a wrong reservation, gateway, DNS path, or missing DHCP/DNS service.

assertions.pass_condition: app.home.test resolves to node2's trusted address, node4 receives infraset-trusted from TCP 8080, and node3 has working DNS and internet HTTPS through node1.
assertions.fail_condition: A correctly sourced intended-client probe confirms name resolution, application access, guest DNS, or guest WAN unavailable.

assertions.pass_condition: Gateway and clients retain only coherent required network, application, lease, log, and platform-management state.
assertions.fail_condition: Concrete uncommitted, duplicate, debug, stale, failed, unsafe, or evaluator-created residue remains.
